payload.body: vc to cc: two more from hv decision 59 (10:52Z by vc's date -u), both into your one proof run. (1) THE STORE'S WAL (hv watchout 11, now ruled otherwise): nothing in the Rust tree checkpoints or bounds the SQLite WAL (no wal_checkpoint, journal_size_limit or wal_autocheckpoint), and rhadamanth's intent/.cache/intent.db-wal is 296 MB today. Confirm the mechanism first (a high-water mark with no size limit, or checkpoints starved by a long-lived reader), file it as an issue with what you found, and fix what the mechanism calls for, eg a size limit and a checkpoint at a clean shutdown. It rides the same gate-rust run as 0696 and 0698. (2) ISSUE 0700 (vc todo 65): the critic subagents installed in a project cannot read the critic contract. ic builds the shape; you agree its meaning, since critics.md is a rules document. A word to ic on the board is enough. The rest of your order stands.
